item.title: 12 things to do in San Diego this weekend
item.description: From live music to cultural festivals and sporting events, there are a variety of activities to enjoy in San Diego this weekend, including the San Diego FC home opener, the Spirit of Japan San Diego festival, the Oceanside International Film Festival, the San Diego Tết Festival, the Hello Kitty Cafe Truck, the San Diego Seals Margaritaville Night, the Balboa Park Chinese New Year Fair, a tribute concert to The Eagles, the "The Art of Banksy Without Limits" exhibit, Mardi Gras at SeaWorld San Die

item.title: Mountain lion trapped by San Diego County family
item.description: A Fallbrook family got an unexpected and unsettling surprise this week when a mountain lion turned up in a backyard trap set to catch whatever had been killing their animals.

item.title: Fire burns through roof of vacant home in University Heights
item.description: Crews battled a commercial house fire in University Heights on Saturday morning, protecting the surrounding homes and buildings with no injuries reported and the structure declared a complete loss.

item.title: Full list of concerts at the Rady Shell in 2026
item.description: The Rady Shell, a waterfront open-air venue in San Diego, has hosted major acts since its opening in 2021 and will feature global performers such as Paul Simon, Sarah McLachlan, and "Weird Al" Yankovic in its 2026 lineup.

item.title: Three San Diegans honored during Black History Month
item.description: A Black History Month celebration at Oak Park Library on Saturday honored three local women for their contributions to the creative arts and education.

item.title: Over 680 properties going up for auction in San Diego County
item.description: People can now register to bid on more than 680 properties available through this year's online property tax auction.

item.title: Man accused of sexually battering two women in Spring Valley
item.description: A 47-year-old man is accused of sexually battering two women in Spring Valley early Saturday morning.

item.title: Dry, warm weather to continue across the county
item.description: Daily highs in San Diego will remain above average on Sunday, with temperatures ranging from 62 to 77 degrees, and will continue to rise throughout the week, reaching the 80s and 90s in the inland valleys and deserts by Thursday.

item.title: San Diego police warn popular “Senior Assassin” game could lead to dangerous situations
item.description: Police are not banning the game but are urging parents to speak with their teens about the risks, especially when using toy guns that resemble real firearms.

item.title: Driver flees scene after fatal collision in San Marcos
item.description: A pedestrian was killed in a hit-and-run crash Saturday evening in San Marcos, and the suspect who fled the scene on foot remains at large.
